reviews.text:
Hello Floww B,

Thank you so much for your excellent rating and support! We are delighted to know that you were satisfied with your experience at Animalis Marseille 11 - La Valentine.

We look forward to welcoming you back again very soon.

Sincerely,
The Animalis Marseille 11 - La Valentine Team
Excellent welcome and advice. Easy to use and friendly service.
Excellent welcome and very good advice from the saleswoman BIANCA – finally a competent saleswoman! You can tell she loves what she does. I will come back with my dog, thank you!
Loyalty program; not all my purchases earn money. Convenient location. Parking.
First time at Animalis in La Valentine, the welcome and advice from the team were top-notch, and a special mention to Bianca, the sales advisor, who was incredible from beginning to end.
Great! The seller was very kind and gave me excellent advice!
A young woman who gave excellent advice, and was also very courteous and patient. The manager was great too!

A huge thank you to the team at Animalis La Valentine, and especially to Inès, for her warm welcome and exceptional professionalism.

I came to buy a little Russian dwarf hamster 🐹 and Inès gave me excellent advice. She took the time to explain its needs, diet, environment, and the best practices for welcoming it home.

I particularly appreciated her attentiveness, availability, and the quality of her advice, given with great seriousness and kindness. It's clear she knows her job perfectly and truly cares about animal welfare.

Thank you again, Inès, for this wonderful service! A truly great experience at Animalis La Valentine. 🐹❤️

Excellent in-store customer experience.

I found everything I needed for my new pet thanks to the helpful advice in store.
The next day, I had a problem with an item, and the staff provided excellent after-sales service.
I will gladly return.

Hello Flore Genella,

Thank you so much for your excellent rating and feedback. We are delighted that you were satisfied with your experience at Animalis Marseille 11 - La Valentine.

We look forward to welcoming you back to our store very soon.

Sincerely,
The Animalis Marseille 11 - La Valentine Team
Friendly welcome, lots of items even if they are a bit pricey, but with my loyalty card it becomes attractive.

The store was very good, but unfortunately, no help was offered to carry a large box to the car. I was a woman alone with a large box of cat trees. The only assistance they provided was opening the door.

I discovered this store in Marseille on my way back from vacation. Already delighted with the store in Aubagne, I'm certain that after a month or two of getting settled in, it will be fantastic, and Maxi Zoo, its direct competitor, will have to face the music. Animalis is the best.

I'm delighted to have this store nearby and also to have received excellent service from the young woman who helped me. She was even kind enough to hold the cat food for my "old man" (it was the last bag) until it arrived at the store. Thank you so much 🙏 …

Very courteous and friendly staff on the phone, a rare quality these days. They were very helpful when I made a mistake with my order.

Highly recommended.

It's a shame this shop is located next to another pet store that's much cheaper!

I don't give it much of a chance of lasting...

I'm thrilled to finally have an Animalis in La Valentine, and to be able to find Arlo's favorite products without having to go all the way to Aubagne.

The store is clean, well laid out, and it's easy to find what you're looking for.

The store staff are very friendly, and I especially love Bianca, whom Arlo adores! 🥹
